title: Cold Room

objectives.text: Mr. Kallis pays like a gentleman
Yiannis shows you the cold room
Stick-up crew hits the fur vault
objectives.note: Midday fur-vault robbery. Yiannis's crew hides; Teddy holds the door. Cops among the targets are ordinary killable police (heat only).

objectives.text: Say a name and watch Mayhew

fail.note: Wasted: retry from checkpoint (hospital flow, Gameplay).
Arrested: retry from checkpoint (booking flow, Gameplay).
Shown as '<Name> died'. Retry from checkpoint; offer a skip after repeated failures.

mobile: Three short walks within the Fur District with no timers. The vault interior is cold, so breath shows (a visual cue only).
design: Maps the vaults for M15 and M18. Seeds Mayhew's secret: if Teddy says 'Lisle', Mayhew drops his toothpick (N3 §6). Nick is absent ('Mr. Varelas is at the bank'), which builds anticipation. COMBAT (26 Nov): see COMBAT table in build_act23_missions.py.
conventions: FEATURE_AUDIT 'Mission conventions': cop kills feed heat only; 'Lose the police' gates on requireNoHeat objectives; fail only for standard reasons.
